app.name: MevaCare AI Health Companion
app.tagline: Your personal health intelligence, explained calmly.
app.disclaimer: MevaCare provides wellness information only. It does not diagnose, prescribe or replace a doctor. In an emergency call your local emergency number (112 in the EU).

common.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.networkError: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

auth.signInSubtitle: Sign in to continue to your health companion.
auth.signUpSubtitle: Start with a private, secure space for your health data.
auth.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A long passphrase is best.
auth.acceptTerms: I accept the Terms of Service and the Privacy Policy.
auth.healthConsent: I agree that MevaCare may process my health data (profile, nutrition, measurements) to provide the service.
auth.aiConsent: I agree that my messages and the minimum necessary context may be sent to the configured AI provider to generate answers.
auth.consentsOptional: The two optional consents can be changed at any time in Settings → Privacy & Consent.
auth.invalidCredentials: Invalid e-mail or password, or the account is temporarily locked.
auth.emailInUse: An account with this e-mail address already exists.

dashboard.subtitle: Here is what MevaCare knows about you today.
dashboard.profileEmpty: Add your basic details so calorie targets and trends can be personalised.
dashboard.consentNeeded: Health data processing is switched off. Turn it on in Privacy & Consent to use your profile.
dashboard.goalsEmpty: You have not set any goals yet.
dashboard.availableWith: Available with the nutrition module (next phase).
dashboard.availableWithMeasurements: Available with health measurements and wearable integration (later phase).
dashboard.availableWithInsights: Available once enough of your own data has been collected (later phase).

comingSoon.title: Not available yet
comingSoon.body: This area is planned but has not been built. Nothing shown here is real data.

profile.title: Health profile
profile.subtitle: Used to personalise targets and to give context to the AI companion. Only what you enter here is stored.

activityValues.ExtraActive: Extra active (physical job or twice-daily training)

profile.goalsHelp: Goals are personal targets, not medical prescriptions.
profile.goalLimit: You can have at most 5 goals.
profile.consentRequiredTitle: Health data processing is switched off
profile.consentRequiredBody: To store your profile and goals, allow health data processing.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.subtitle: How MevaCare looks and which units it uses.

privacy.title: Privacy & Consent
privacy.subtitle: You decide how your data is used. Every change is recorded in an audit log.

TermsOfService.title: Terms of Service and Privacy Policy
TermsOfService.body: Required to have an account. It can only be withdrawn by deleting the account.

HealthDataProcessing.title: Health data processing
HealthDataProcessing.body: Allows MevaCare to store and use your health profile, goals, nutrition and measurements. Without it those features stay locked.

AiProcessing.title: AI processing
AiProcessing.body: Allows sending your chat messages, and only the context needed to answer them, to the configured AI provider.

ExternalIntegrations.title: External integrations
ExternalIntegrations.body: Allows connecting wearables and other services (not available yet).

privacy.exportBody: Download everything MevaCare stores about you as a JSON file.
privacy.deleteBody: Permanently deletes your account and all associated data. This cannot be undone. A minimal audit record without personal data is kept for security.

aiSettings.title: AI Settings
aiSettings.subtitle: Control how the AI companion may use your information.
aiSettings.consentOffHelp: The AI companion is disabled until you allow AI processing.
aiSettings.whatIsSentTitle: What is sent to the AI provider
aiSettings.whatIsSent1: The messages you type in the chat and recent messages from the same conversation.
aiSettings.whatIsSent2: Short safety and style instructions written by MevaCare.
aiSettings.whatIsSent3: Never your e-mail address, password, tokens or your complete profile.
aiSettings.limits1: The assistant gives wellness information. It does not diagnose, prescribe or change medication.
aiSettings.limits2: It can make mistakes. Check important information with a qualified professional.
aiSettings.providerBody: The model provider is configured on the server by the operator of this installation.

chat.title: AI Companion
chat.subtitle: Ask about wellness, sleep, food and health terms.
chat.emptyBody: I can explain health terms and help you think about habits. I cannot diagnose or prescribe.
chat.failed: The answer could not be completed.
chat.providerDown: The AI service is not available right now. Please try again in a moment.
chat.consentBody: To use the AI companion, allow AI processing. Your messages are then sent to the configured AI provider.
chat.emergency: If you think this may be an emergency, call your local emergency number now.

suggestions.protein: How much protein does a healthy adult generally need?
suggestions.sleep: Give me practical tips for better sleep.
suggestions.plateau: Why might weight loss slow down?
